summary: Live regression passed anonymous redirect, admin bcrypt login, seeded catalog/categories, Add App validation and creation, normal-user scoping, and authorization denials. One legacy test failed because it hardcodes the original 36-app seed count after a UI-created test app persisted.

minor.issue: Assertion expects exactly 36 apps, but live demo data contains 37 after the persisted UI Iteration 5 App; use a minimum/cleanup-based assertion.

action_items: Update the stale admin catalog-count regression to clean temporary data or assert seeded baseline plus created records.
Keep the demo UI-created record isolated or reseed Mongo before future exact-count tests.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/tests/conftest.py defaults to localhost instead of requiring the configured environment URL; this did not block collection but can target the wrong service.

frontend/src/lib/api.ts uses a relative /api base and frontend/.env has VITE_API_BASE rather than the requested REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL; the current same-origin proxy works, but deployment configuration should be made consistent with the environment contract.
seed_data_creation: Created one uniquely named UI Iteration 5 App through the admin UI; it remains in the demo catalog and caused the exact-count regression failure.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin API/UI and John Doe UI/API scoping passed. Admin login set catalog_session as HttpOnly/SameSite=lax; both seeded hashes begin with $2b$ and no login 500 occurred. No core console/API errors were observed. Exact admin count test must account for the persisted UI app.
rca of the issue: The failing test is data-state dependent: the previous UI flow intentionally creates an app and does not delete it, while test_tscheck_admin_unrestricted.py asserts an immutable count of 36. This is a regression-test isolation issue, not an application catalog or authorization defect.
